verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover command-line cooking: the commandlet `UnrealEditor.exe <uproject> -run=cook -targetplatform=...` cooks content per platform. The Unreal Automation Tool is documented as a system for automating the testing and building of games. A single build command can cook, package into the platform's native distribution format, deploy and run the project. Together these give the core build-and-export pipeline with no editor clicking. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of headless/unattended flags or CI-runner integration, and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless CI builds.
